intro.narration: [excited] Heey — a remainder after dividing by nine, without ever dividing? [pause] Watch this.

steps.narration: [curious] Six thousand six hundred fifty-six, divided by nine. [pause] What is left over?
[confident] Just add the digits. Six plus six plus five plus six … twenty-three.
[curious] Still two digits? [pause] Add again. Two plus three is five.
[excited] Five is the remainder. Nine times seven hundred thirty-nine, plus five.
[thoughtful] One catch. Nine hundred ninety-nine lands on nine. [pause] A nine means zero.
